description: Consumo eléctrico por sectores manufactureros is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Industria, Comercio y de la Pequeña y Mediana Empresa. Datos mensuales de consumo eléctrico en MWh correspondiente a los Grandes Usuarios Mayores (GUMA) y Grandes Usuarios Menores (GUME). La información es provista por CAMMESA a nivel de planta industrial y se presenta agregada por sectores de la industria manufacturera según clasificación de plantas propia del CEP XXI. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Industria, Comercio y de la Pequeña y Mediana Empresa. Its tags are CAMMESA, Energía eléctrica, Sectores manufactureros. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
